rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Watch out for planting jargon too early.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L84: "...while the room is already running STRIDE." and L88: "Optional. Lands the modern agentic-security frame before STRIDE and access-control." STRIDE is named bare with zero primer; it is earned properly (named, expanded, sourced to Kohnfelder/Garg/Shostack) only in the M3 file (earn-the-trust.md), where the module's own exercises and lecture actually land it. Per this rule and the signposting carve-out's own diagnostic in check_student_facing.md §2 ("term never lands inside module → signposting itself is bug"), STRIDE does not land inside THIS module's own exercises or lectures, so the forward-mention in ## Next is premature planting, not earned signposting.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Either drop the bare acronym in favor of a plain description ("the room is already running the security threat-model") or add a three-to-five-word gloss the first time it appears in this file's body.
